🌿 The “Walk With VC” community proudly organises the iNat Keralam Kannur Edition Meetup at the Neeliyarkottam Sacred Grove: a day of nature walking, biodiversity documentation on iNaturalist, and talks.
📆 Date: Saturday, 21 November 2026
⏰ Time: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
⛳ Venue: Neeliyarkottam Sacred Grove, Mangattuparamba, Kannur (1.5 km west of Dharmashala junction on the Kannur–Taliparamba route)
Registration fee: Rs. 200/-
The registration form link is shared along with the brochure. Accommodation will not be arranged for participants.
     Program Schedule    Time Programme     9:00 AM Reporting time and tea   9:30 AM Inaugural ceremony   10:15 AM – 1:00 PM Nature walk and documentation   1:00 – 2:00 PM Lunch   2:00 – 2:45 PM Talk 1   2:45 – 3:30 PM Talk 2   3:30 – 4:00 PM Summary of the walk    The theyyam ritual at the grove begins at 5:00 PM and ends at 6:30 PM. Participants who wish to witness it can stay on after the meetup formally ends at 4:00 PM. This is optional.
Neeliyarkottam Sacred Grove Neeliyarkottam sacred grove, where “Neeli Bhagavathi” is worshipped and devotedly referred to as “Kottathamma”, is located at Mangattuparamba, 1.5 km west of Dharmashala junction on the Kannur–Taliparamba route. It extends over approximately 24 acres under private ownership, and the owners are supportive of research and conservation efforts there. It is a liana-rich sacred grove known for its rare wild orchids, and around 190 vascular plants have been recorded from the grove. The theyyam here is popular, as the devi’s entry from the vegetation at sunset is a divine scene for devotees.
About the Organisers: Walk With VC “Walk With VC” is a Kerala-based community founded by the renowned environmentalist Sri. V. C. Balakrishnan, popularly known as “V. C.”. The community stands for the study, documentation and conservation of biodiversity. Under V. C.’s mentorship, the community, which has more than 150 members, carries out nature walks, camps, activities and challenges for children, awareness programmes and a popular webinar series.
It began in July 2022, when V. C. posted on Facebook about one of his casual visits to Shoolap Kavu, Cheemeni. Many from his circle wanted to join him on the next visit, and that nature walk became the starting point of the team.
Everyone is welcome to attend.
summary: The Walk With VC community organises the iNat Keralam Kannur Edition Meetup at Neeliyarkottam Sacred Grove, Mangattuparamba, on Saturday, 21 November 2026, with a nature walk, documentation and talks.
title: iNat Keralam Kannur Edition Meetup at Neeliyarkottam Sacred Grove

National Moth Week is an annual global event that encourages people of all ages and backgrounds to participate in mothing by sharing photos of the moths they discover. Taking place in July, this week-long celebration promotes citizen science, as participants contribute their findings to help researchers study moth diversity, distribution, and ecology worldwide. By engaging in this collective effort, individuals not only enjoy the beauty of moths but also play a vital role in advancing scientific knowledge about these important creatures.
As part of National Moth Week, an event is organized at Aralam Wildlife Sanctuary in association with Aralam Wildlife Division, Kerala Forest and Wildlife Department at Aralam Wildlife Sanctuary from 19 - 20 July, 2025.
Join us for an engaging program,
Event : Moth Night
Date : 19 -20 July, 2025
Venue : Aralam Wildlife Sanctuary, Kannur.
Everyone is welcome to attend this event.

Sathyabhama Das Biju, born in May 1963, is a renowned Indian amphibian biologist and wildlife conservationist, often referred to as the “Frogman of India.” He heads the Systematics Lab at the University of Delhi’s Department of Environmental Studies and is recognized for his significant contributions to amphibian research, including the discovery of over 100 new species and two new families of amphibians. Biju has received numerous accolades for his work, including the Sanctuary Wildlife Service Award and the Kerala Sree Award. His passion for amphibians and dedication to conservation have made him a leading figure in the field.
Join us for an engaging program,
Event : "Talk with Dr. S D Biju"
Date : September 5, 2024, at 4 PM 
Venue : Sahitya Akademi Hall, Thrissur.
Everyone is welcome to attend this insightful discussion with Sathyabhama Das Biju, where he will share his experiences and knowledge about amphibian conservation and research. Don’t miss this opportunity to learn from one of the world’s foremost amphibian experts!
